selected_evidence.requirement: Persist the currently supplied DNS nameserver and add infra.test as the system search domain
selected_evidence.summary: The baseline identifies 10.100.61.1 as the supplied DNS server. Before and after reboot, the NetworkManager profile explicitly contains 10.100.61.1 and infra.test, /etc/resolv.conf matches, and example.com resolves successfully.

Healthy pre-restart boot ID 368725cb-c64e-4393-b25f-da5111703b4a was captured, the delayed native reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with changed boot ID 97756ae6-6d54-4f18-ada1-a04df210d464. NetworkManager, the active profile, persistent DNS/search settings, and DNS resolution all recovered.
